notice: These spatial data are considered to be approximate representations and are NOT an OFFICIAL record for the exact regulated area boundaries. For information on the official legal definition refer to the Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR 50 CFR 660.70).
caveat: Emergency and in-season closures are not in these files: they close a fishery for a time by notice (the Federal Register, a regional office's bulletin), not by a new boundary. A management area's GIS is not its legal definition; the regulation's text is.
